title: SCA Minhag of the Week 279: "Birkat Kohanim in Shahrit on Tish'a BeAb"

chapters.title: Introduction to Birkat Kohanim on Tisha B'Ab
The reason behind the custom
chapters.about: Mourner, house of mourning, shalom, beraha

chapters.title: Sources from Hahamim
chapters.about: Shulchan Aruch, Tanya Bati, David Abudraham, Haham Chaim Ber Benisti

chapters.title: Evidence from prayer books
chapters.about: Prayer books, Syrian community, Argentina, Egypt, Ben Ish Hai

summary: Joey Harari explores whether Birkat Kohanim should be recited during Shahrit on Tisha B'Ab. He explains the traditional community custom not to do so, comparing it to a mourner in a house of mourning and referencing various Hahamim and community prayer books.
questions: Do we do Birkat Kohanim on Tisha B'Ab morning in Shahrit?
What is the custom of Sephardic communities regarding Birkat Kohanim on Tisha B'Ab morning?
Why do some Hahamim liken Tisha B'Ab morning to a mourner in a house of mourning?
What does the pesuk in Yeshayahu teach us about spreading hands during times of sinat chinam?
What do community prayer books from Syria, Argentina, and Egypt indicate about Birkat Kohanim on Tisha B'Ab?
